Crime & Law · India

Clashes in India result in injuries to police and protesters

During separate events in India, law enforcement officers and protesters sustained injuries. In Odisha, three police personnel were reportedly injured during an encounter with alleged ganja peddlers. Separately, during a 'Chalo Sansad' protest, police sources stated that over 50 officers were injured in clashes with demonstrators. The incidents highlight tensions during law enforcement actions and public demonstrations.
